steps.title: Listen, then write
body: Dictation is writing down a word you hear. You do not see it first — you turn the sounds into letters.
For each word: tap 🔊 Listen as many times as you need, say the word to yourself, then build it from the letter tiles. Use 🐢 Slower if the sounds run together.
Every word here is one you have already met, so you are spelling from memory, not guessing.

steps.title: Hear the ten words
steps.intro: Listen to each word first and read along. In the next step you will spell them with only the sound to go on.

steps.title: Which word was it?
steps.prompt: Listen and choose the word you hear.

steps.title: You took ten words from dictation
steps.message: You heard ten A1 words and spelled each one from the sound alone. That is the writing you use to take notes and send a message.
